name: Nardey
source:
Nardey (full name is Nardey Ahness) – is a character in Heralds of the Avirentes - Ch. 1 Wings of Change.
Nardeys is a nearly old bronze blue-eyed om'verai with a 3-edged eye mask and sharp "beard". Nardey's belly is covered with dark plates and wing membranes are dark.
Nardey is a serious person who loves a good company to drink some alcohol with, especially "Eastern Eorin at Aratikain". Nardey doesn't mind a company of younger people, especially if they are helpful and well-manered. Hates nentals for unknown reasons.
